svg.aria-label: The same requests before and after the work of 23 to 27 November 2026: a deep research run went from 58.1 to 29.7 minutes, a slide deck from 55 to 7.3 minutes, themes from a data pack from 30 to 6.9 minutes, archiving 74 sources in HiC from 9.1 minutes to 162 seconds, a question about today's news from 35 minutes to 13.6 seconds, and a median chat reply from 11.9 to 3.4 seconds.
